senses.gloss: (cmp. עקב, a. Arab. ʿaḳaṣ) [to bend, twist; denom. עוּקָץ tail, point, peduncle &c.,]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:3">Peah VII, 3</cite> <he>ע׳ את כל האשכול</he> Ms. M. if he cut an entire cluster.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 70b:11">B. Kam. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>עֲקוֹץ לך תאינה מתאינתי וכ׳</he> cut figs (to the value of the stolen object) in my fig plantation, and take possession for me of the stolen object which thou holdest; a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5:7">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שעֲקָצוֹ חברבר וחיה</he> that a lizard stung him, and he recovered.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12:2">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>אפי׳ פורטענא לא ע׳ בם</he> not even a flea stung them; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:3:1">ib. to V, 3</cite> <he>עָקְצָה</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:15:2">Ib. to II, 15</cite> <he>ועוֹקְצִין אותם</he> and they pricked them (with a pin); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> (proverbial expression) <he>רמזתו ולא נרמז עֲקָצַתּוּ ולא נעקץ</he> she gave him a hint, and he did not heed it, she pricked him, and he did not feel the sting.

senses.gloss: to be stung, feel the sting, v. supra.
